title: VaultResetResult
description: Result of the vault.reset JSON-RPC method: what was actually destroyed, and what could not be. The vault is uninitialized afterwards whether or not every store answered, so this is a success shape with residue rather than an error.

secretCount.description: Distinct stored secrets whose references were cleared.

profileCount.description: Connections that held at least one of them and will ask for a password again.

residue.description: Stores whose material could not be removed — empty when everything was. The renderer must not say 'everything was deleted' while this is non-empty. Always an array, never null: a null where the renderer's type says list has cost this project a defect once already (nocx-25k9.14).

store.description: Provider id of the store that still holds material.

reason.description: Why it could not be cleared. A code, never a sentence — the renderer owns the wording. Absent when the failure carried no reason code.
